snippet.title: Webinar: Building Resilient Energy Systems with Industrial Networking | Moxa
snippet.description:
As the energy landscape rapidly transforms with the integration of renewables, energy storage, EVs, and advanced grid intelligence, the demand for robust networking and edge computing solutions has never been greater. This webinar will showcase how industrial-grade technologies are enabling seamless data acquisition, real-time control, and resilient communication across modern power systems.

Through real-world applications—ranging from substation automation and intelligent distribution networks to mission-critical data centers and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)—we’ll explore how these solutions deliver reliability, cybersecurity, and long-term scalability. Whether you're a utility operator, systems integrator, or OEM, you’ll gain valuable insights into building smarter, safer, and more connected energy systems.

Key Takeaways:
• Learn how industrial-grade networking and edge computing drive real-time control, resilient communication, and data acquisition in modern power infrastructures.
• Explore critical applications across substation automation, intelligent distribution networks, data centers, and BESS facilities, emphasizing reliability, cybersecurity, and scalability.
• Understand how these technologies facilitate the integration of renewables, energy storage, EVs, and advanced grid intelligence.
• Gain actionable insights for utility operators, systems integrators, and OEMs to future-proof and enhance energy system performance.

Learn more: https://pages.moxa.com/us-power.html?utm_medium=video&utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=202507-energy-webinar&utm_term=701Vg00000RmWRD

Ever since Donut Lab announced their miracle solid-state battery, the internet has been absolutely certain about what it is. A capacitor. Vaporware. A scam. Except when you actually dig into those explanations, a lot of them start falling apart. Here's what Donut Lab is actually claiming: more energy per pound than today's best lithium cells. No lithium. No cobalt. No hard-to-get metals. And a battery that charges in five minutes, but lasts a lifetime. Some experts say those specs are physically impossible. Others think they've already cracked the case and figured out who really built this thing and what's actually inside. We don't know yet if Donut Lab's claims will hold up. They’ve been releasing third-party tests slowly over the past few weeks. But let's take a closer look at what this battery could be…  what it probably isn't... and what Donut Lab could possibly gain by exaggerating its claims.  It’s not as clear-cut as you might think.

Or should you go with an air source heat pump instead? I've been living with my geothermal system for two years now. I reached out to my friend Paul Braren, who installed an air source heat pump system in his home around the same time I was building mine. We're both in New England, we both have detailed energy monitoring, and we both ditched fossil fuels completely. It’s the perfect setup for a real-world comparison. Here's the thing, though. After crunching the numbers, this isn't going to be the straightforward "geothermal wins" or "air source is better" story you might expect. The actual data surprised both of us.
